brief: @buildthis.bisks.net burning house simulator where you save as many cats as possible by clicking on the house, however, the house only has a few cats, so you must add cats to the fire to then remove them, which risks burning the cats
note: built purrscue.bisks.net — click the burning house to save a cat, but it only ever has a few, so scoring again means throwing a safe one back in and racing its clock.
